reason: The cited evidence (E1) supports graphene's high strength and modulus, and that metal-graphene interfaces can increase strength in Cu and Al composites, but it provides no evidence for graphene's thermal conductivity, its localization at W/Cu interfaces, or its chemical stability under irradiation and high temperature. The key premise of enhanced thermal conductivity is entirely unsupported by the cited passage.
premises: Graphene has exceptionally high in-plane thermal conductivity
Graphene has high mechanical strength and modulus
Graphene-metal interfaces can increase composite strength
Graphene can be localized at W/Cu interfaces during processing
Graphene is chemically stable under the specified conditions
